change: Readable P2P refusals: login accepts the email users register with, and every refusal gets a truthful message instead of one generic configuration warning

state_matrix.test: signs in with the address the coordinator keys the account by
state_matrix.semantics: The login form is type=email and every account is keyed by email server side. assertAccountUsername previously refused '@', so sign-in was impossible for every real account.

state_matrix.test: explains a rejected value instead of blaming the configuration
state_matrix.semantics: A refused input is the user's to fix. It must not present as a configuration fault with only a raw code.

state_matrix.test: does not report an unregistered device as a failure
state_matrix.semantics: p2p.credential_unavailable means nothing is stored yet, which is the normal state before enrollment, not an error.

state_matrix.test: never downgrades an unconfirmed result to a plain failure
state_matrix.semantics: An unconfirmed write must keep claiming neither outcome; classification must not collapse it into a generic failure.
busy, limit, timeout and cancelled invite the same action again rather than a configuration audit.

state_matrix.test: separates being signed out from a failure
state_matrix.semantics: An expired session reads as signed out, so the sign-in form is the answer rather than an alert.

state_matrix.test: classifies an unknown future code as a fault rather than throwing
state_matrix.semantics: A helper that grows a new code must not break the renderer or lose its message.

field_bindings.source: P2P_MANAGEMENT_ERROR_CODES, the full allowed set returned over IPC
field_bindings.test: classifies every allowed code, so no refusal is left without a category
field_bindings.missing_semantics: An unlisted or future code classifies as 'fault' and still yields a message; classification never throws.

field_bindings.source: operation.error from the management domain, produced by a real owner refusal
field_bindings.test: explains a rejected value instead of blaming the configuration
field_bindings.missing_semantics: The raw code remains visible for reporting; absence of a specific key falls back to the category line, never to a configuration warning.

field_bindings.source: The email a user registers with, as the coordinator stores and returns it
field_bindings.test: signs in with the address the coordinator keys the account by
field_bindings.missing_semantics: The narrower handle form stays accepted so a coordinator issuing one is not locked out; over-254-byte and control-character values are still refused.

field_bindings.test: does not report an unregistered device as a failure
field_bindings.missing_semantics: Both codes mean nothing is stored for this service, which is what the registration panel below exists to resolve.

field_bindings.source: The refusal categories produced by p2pRefusalKind
field_bindings.test: defines the same message keys in every catalog
field_bindings.missing_semantics: A category without copy in either catalog fails key parity; an empty string fails the non-empty check.

field_bindings.source: zhCNRefusals spread into the primary catalog
field_bindings.test: defines the same message keys in every catalog
field_bindings.missing_semantics: A key present in one locale only is a failure, so a refusal cannot render as a raw key.

field_bindings.source: enUSRefusals spread into the primary catalog
field_bindings.test: translates every message rather than copying one catalog into the other
field_bindings.missing_semantics: Copying Chinese text into the English catalog fails; the file also stays inside the 1000-line budget enforced by architecture:check.

field_bindings.source: The email the coordinator stores for the account
field_bindings.test: signs in with the address the coordinator keys the account by
field_bindings.missing_semantics: A refused value never reaches the helper, so the password does not leave the process.

field_bindings.source: NetworkDevices readback from a real coordinator process
field_bindings.missing_semantics: The directory withholds credential material, so identity is confirmed by the fields it carries; presence must be a usable value.

runtime_evidence.note: Public-UI run against the live coordinator: signed out, malformed input, then the registered email. Every step records alive, alert count and signedIn.
Same run with the crash list, which is empty. Signed-out shows signedIn false with zero alerts; the registered email reaches signedIn true.

acceptance_status: Accepted for the refusal-presentation and login-validator change. 1121 renderer tests, type-check, format and architecture gates pass; Go networking builds. networking/internal/runtimebridge fails to build on macOS from a pre-existing Windows-only syscall constant, outside this change. The integration package now compiles after correcting a DeviceEntry field reference this change made stale.
